plain: Every shipment of hydrocodone and oxycodone pills from drug companies to pharmacies and doctors, 2006 to 2012, as reported to the DEA.
author: claude-code

plain: One shipment line: one pill product, from one seller to one buyer, on one day.
author: claude-code

plain: The seller's own line number on its report. It repeats across sellers and years, so it is not a row ID: use ARCOS_ROW_KEY.

author: claude-code

author: claude-code

plain: What kind of business the seller is. Almost all are distributors; about 0.3% are drug makers.

plain: The seller's business name, as typed on its DEA registration.

author: claude-code

author: claude-code

plain: Milligrams of drug in each pill, like 5 or 10.
